title: Convection
notes: **Convection:** heat transfer by bulk movement of a fluid (liquid or gas). It occurs only in fluids because fluids can flow.
**Natural convection:** fluid moves because of density differences caused by temperature gradients. Hot fluid rises, cold fluid sinks, setting up a circulation current.
**Forced convection:** fluid is driven by an external agent such as a pump, fan, or wind. Heat transfer rate is higher because the flow is faster and more controlled.
**Why radiators are placed low:** hot air rises from the radiator, drawing cooler air in from below, creating a circulation that heats the whole room.
**Land and sea breezes:** during the day, land heats faster than sea, so warm air rises over land and cool air moves in from sea (sea breeze). At night the reverse happens (land breeze).
